function.name: bash
function.arguments:
{"command":"cd /testbed && python - <<'PY'
p='schema/__init__.py'
s=open(p).read()
old='''def _invoke_with_optional_kwargs(f: Callable[..., Any], **kwargs: Any) -> Any:\n    return f(**kwargs)\n    s = inspect.signature(f)\n    if len(s.parameters) == 0:\n        return f()\n'''
new='''def _invoke_with_optional_kwargs(f: Callable[..., Any], **kwargs: Any) -> Any:\n    try:\n        s = inspect.signature(f)\n    except (TypeError, ValueError):\n        # Some built-in callables (for example dict) do not expose a signature.\n        return f(**kwargs)\n    if len(s.parameters) == 0:\n        return f()\n    return f(**kwargs)\n'''
assert old in s
open(p,'w').write(s.replace(old,new))
p='test_schema.py'
s=open(p).read()
needle='''def test_optional_callable_default_ignore_inherited_schema_validate_kwargs():\n'''
insert='''def test_optional_callable_default_without_kwargs_ignores_schema_validate_kwargs():\n    s = {\n        "k": int,\n        "d": {\n            Optional("k", default=lambda: 42): int,\n            "l": [{"l": [int]}],\n        },\n    }\n    v = {"k": 1, "d": {"l": [{"l": [3, 4, 5]}]}}\n    assert Schema(s).validate(v, increment=1) == {\n        "k": 1, "d": {"k": 42, "l": [{"l": [3, 4, 5]}]}\n    }\n\n\ndef test_optional_callable_default_receives_schema_validate_kwargs():\n    s = {Optional("value", default=lambda increment: increment + 41): int}\n    assert Schema(s).validate({}, increment=1) == {"value": 42}\n\n\n'''
assert needle in s
open(p,'w').write(s.replace(needle,insert+needle))
PY
python /tmp/schema_optional_defaults_repro.py && python -m pytest -q && git diff --check && git diff -- schema/__init__.py test_schema.py"}
